translations.item: Check that a document from the Centre Excursionista d'Alcoi is authentic: enter the verification code printed at the bottom of its pages, choose its PDF file, or both.
Enter a verification code, or choose a PDF file.
That isn't a verification code. They have 12 letters and numbers, like ABCD-EFGH-JKMN.
No document has this verification code.
This code belongs to a document generated by the Centre Excursionista d'Alcoi.
To check that a copy is exactly this document, with no changes, choose its PDF file below.
The file is authentic: it's exactly the document generated by the Centre Excursionista d'Alcoi, with no changes.
This file isn't the document with this verification code: it may have been changed.
This file wasn't generated by the Centre Excursionista d'Alcoi, or it has been changed since.
The file is too large to be a document generated by the Centre Excursionista d'Alcoi.
